mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, stat_month, appointment_count, email_count, sms_count, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_usage_stats (tenant_id, stat_month, appointment_count, email_count, sms_count) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{statMonth}, #{appointmentCount}, #{emailCount}, #{smsCount})
mapper.update: INSERT INTO tenant_usage_stats (tenant_id, stat_month, appointment_count) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{statMonth}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE appointment_count = appointment_count + 1
INSERT INTO tenant_usage_stats (tenant_id, stat_month, email_count) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{statMonth}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE email_count = email_count + 1
INSERT INTO tenant_usage_stats (tenant_id, stat_month, sms_count) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{statMonth}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sms_count = sms_count + 1
